Arrow Turret.description: The arrow turret is a sturdy and well versitile turret that shoots individual arrows at enemies.
Arrow Turret.levelTwo: Arrows that are fired from the turret track enemies so they never miss.

Mini Sentry Turret.description: A rapid fire turret that doesn't need to reload. Overall good for standing groud.

Railgun Turret.description: Fires a strong piercing projectile with high damage and range, but high reload time.

Energizer Turret.description: Buffs the damage, range, reload time, and projectile speed of a certain amount of turrets in range.

Royal Turret.description: Creates 3 knights that attack enemies too close to the king.

Flame Turret.description: Uses a flamethrower to ignite them and burn them slowly.

Firework Turret.description: Launches a 3 burst of fireworks in a quick succession that do area damage.
